trigger: ILC-EXP-001 supplementary search: Mouabbi 2022 (n=3784 histology-stratified TT), PALMARES-2 2026 (CDK4/6i ILC vs IDC), PIK3CA systematic review PMID 40513789
claim: CDH1 loss in ILC creates a DUAL PI3K hyperactivation axis conferring CDK4/6i resistance and alpelisib sensitivity: (1) DIRECT: CDH1/E-cadherin loss disrupts p85/p110alpha adherens junction complex → PI3Ka constitutive activation (Bahreini 2017); (2) INDIRECT: CDH1 loss releases negative IGF1R regulation → IGF1R → PI3K/AKT amplification (Elangovan 2022, PMID 35665642). Both axes converge on AKT → CDK2/Cyclin E → RB1-independent G1/S bypass → CDK4/6i resistance. Alpelisib overcomes both axes. Clinical urgency: PALMARES-2 2026 + Mouabbi 2022 (n=3784) suggest ILC may have inferior CDK4/6i benefit vs IDC, making post-CDK4/6i ILC the highest-value alpelisib target. PIK3CA mutations in 30-50% of ILC (higher than IDC, PMID 40513789) enriches alpelisib-eligible ILC population. No published trial (SOLAR-1, BYLieve, EPIK-B3) has reported ILC-specific alpelisib response post-CDK4/6i — this gap is now precisely confirmed.

evidence.finding: CDH1 loss disrupts E-cadherin/p85/p110alpha complex → PI3Ka liberation in ILC
CDH1 loss releases IGF1R negative regulation → IGF1R → PI3K/AKT in ILC. Second independent CDH1→PI3K axis.
5-year complete response to PI3K inhibition in CDH1+PIK3CA+NF1-mutant breast cancer.
CDH1+PIK3CA mutations cooperate to induce ILC in mouse models — functionally co-selected.

n=3784 MD Anderson HR+/HER2- mBC: histology-stratified outcomes for CDK4/6i, mTORi, PI3Ki. Establishes ILC vs IDC targeted therapy comparison framework. PI3Ki subgroup provides direct real-world comparator.

PALMARES-2 multicenter real-world: CDK4/6i outcomes by histology ILC vs IDC in HR+/HER2- advanced BC. Signal that ILC may have inferior CDK4/6i benefit — strengthens urgency for post-CDK4/6i ILC-specific strategies.
PIK3CA mutations in 30-50% of ILC vs ~30% IDC. Higher alpelisib-eligible fraction in ILC. Limited prognostic data; no ILC-specific predictive biomarker study.
Alpelisib clinical benefit in PIK3CA-mutated HR+/HER2-; CDK4/6i-pretreated subgroup positive.
~48% PI3K pathway alterations, 90%+ CDH1 mutations in ILC

novelty.note: ILC-specific alpelisib post-CDK4/6i gap precisely confirmed across SOLAR-1, BYLieve, EPIK-B3. Dual-axis CDH1-PI3K model and ILC stratification remain novel.

evidential_quality.note: Mouabbi 2022 (n=3784) + PALMARES-2 2026 provide real-world histology-stratified framework. PIK3CA systematic review confirms molecular enrichment. Clinical case CR (PMID 35663259) + CDH1-IGF1R axis (PMID 35665642). Remaining gap: prospective ILC-specific alpelisib data.

clinical_relevance.note: PALMARES-2 2026 and Mouabbi 2022 suggest ILC has inferior CDK4/6i benefit — directly motivates post-CDK4/6i ILC-specific strategy. PIK3CA enrichment makes alpelisib-eligible ILC fraction larger than IDC.

mechanistic_depth.note: Dual-axis model well-supported. IGF1R connection and direct p85 liberation both grounded in primary literature.

actionability.note: Three immediate actions: (1) retrospective ILC subgroup in Mouabbi MD Anderson dataset; (2) MDA-MB-134VI/SUM44PE cell line protocol (ILC-EXP-004); (3) contact Mouabbi group for PI3Ki ILC subgroup analysis.

specificity.note: ILC-specific mechanism (CDH1 loss), ILC-specific cell lines, ILC-enriched PIK3CA — highly ILC-targeted claim.
